values.title: Browsing over buying
values.description: Instead of rushing you to purchase, we think first about letting you look around and add freely.

values.title: Imagining over shipping
values.description: We care more about the fun of choosing than about a box actually arriving.

values.title: Taste over ownership
values.description: We build a store that records what caught your eye, not what you bought.

rejectionReasons: Your brand seems a little too real, which doesn't fit how NOBUY operates.
The products are viable enough that we couldn't possibly handle them.
Sales potential was detected, so internal policy required a rejection.
The reviewer nearly approved it, then came to their senses.
Listing you would risk making this look like an actual store.
Your brand description was so persuasive that it raised concerns.
The fact that you have products to sell conflicts with our core values.
Your enthusiasm was more intimidating than the products, hence the rejection.
After review, you'd be better off listing at a normal store.
The paperwork is flawless, but we do not have a warehouse.

hero.lead: NOBUY STORE is a fake store built so you can browse the urge to buy safely, and stretch out the thrill just before checkout.

about.title: A fairly convincing About page
about.lead: We believe not buying can also be a good shopping experience.
about.sloganLine2: more of what you want to look at.
about.paragraph1: NOBUY STORE began by imagining a space where you could discover your taste without owning anything. The familiar routine of comparing prices and filling a cart stays exactly the same. Only the final payment is politely omitted.
about.paragraph2: There are no real orders and no real deliveries, but the time you spend choosing is taken quite seriously. Building a store that's genuinely fun without buying things you don't need is our fairly convincing goal.

partner.title: Send a partnership inquiry into the void
partner.lead: You won't actually be listed, but the feeling of inquiring is fully provided.
partner.formTitle: We'll hear your brand's story, at least
partner.formLead: Nothing you type is sent anywhere. Feel free to just pretend to apply.
